panels.general_description: Flowchart of the diagnostic algorithm for suspected vasospastic angina.
panels.detailed_description: A flowchart on a white background with seven text boxes plus a top banner. A gray-lavender banner at the top reads Suspected vasospastic angina. Below it, two pink boxes read Positive for ischemic ECG change* (left) and Borderline or negative for ischemic ECG change (right). Under the left pink box a pink box reads Diagnosis of coronary artery spasm. Under the right pink box a larger pink box reads MDCTA and echocardiographic LV GLS with a second line Daytime or early morning, before nitrate adminitration (printed spelling). Below that are two dark charcoal boxes with white text: Negative remodeling without definite plaque (left) and Significant coronary stenosis with plaque (right). At the bottom, two dark boxes read Empirical medical therapy including CCB, nitrate (left) and Coronary angiography (right). Dark maroon and gray-blue downward arrows connect the boxes, and a thin line from the Diagnosis of coronary artery spasm box runs down the left edge and turns right into the Empirical medical therapy box. No patient names, dates, identifiers, scale or numeric values are printed.
